name: mh
description: A Matt-Pocock-first Claude Code harness. Its tiered pipeline has Fable plan, Sonnet execute, and Opus review with code-counted fix caps, then bug-hunt and a gated final review. Its idea-to-ship flow runs grill, prototype, spec, tickets, and ship. It adds computational deny-gates and advisory sensors, SessionStart doctrine injection, a self-auditing fleet of skills, agents, and hooks, and backend-stack support for Drizzle, MySQL/MariaDB, and gRPC.
